post.text:
Lol not only does Taranaki Maunga have a hat, but Taranaki Maunga's hat has a hat! Hat-ception 🤯

Where/when was this taken? Looks like you were east of the Maunga

In case you didn't know, this type of cloud is called "pileus" from the Latin for "hat" (which itself is derived from Ancient Greek)

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
